review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 16, 7:41 AM ET. It had Cameroon 36%, the draw 31% and Namibia 33%, projecting Cameroon 1.1 – Namibia 1.1 (2.2 total, Cameroon by 0.1).

Final: Cameroon 3 – Namibia 0. Right winner: it had Cameroon at 36%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Cameroon came in with a 10% above average attack and a 14% stingier than average defense (2-1-0, 2 scored and 0.7 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 15 and 15 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.1, they scored 3 (+1.9 goals, 164% over); projected to allow 1.1, they allowed 0 (−1.1 goals, 100% under).

Namibia came in with a 7% below average attack and a 14% stingier than average defense (1-0-2, 0.3 scored and 1 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 15 and 15 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.1, they scored 0 (−1.1 goals, 100% under); projected to allow 1.1, they allowed 3 (+1.9 goals, 164% over).

The bigger miss was Cameroon's scoring (+1.9 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 3 against 2.2 projected (+0.8), about the 68th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: Cameroon by 3 against Cameroon by 0.1 projected, about the 4th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Form (CMR 3-0 L5 · NAM 2-2 L5): Namibia ×1.00, Cameroon ×1.03. It favored Cameroon, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.body:

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: The sharp side by the algo's read was Cameroon, who won and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; inputs were missing (CMR lineup rating or past seasons, NAM lineup rating or past seasons).

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.234 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -3 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1213 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.9 goals), the pick lost (-1u).
